definition: Percentage of 12 deliberately coarse whole-game recompilation acceptance gates satisfied. Not instruction-byte coverage, gameplay equivalence, or a time estimate. Accepted means the scoped gate is supported by independently recorded evidence; later contradictory evidence can revoke it.

gates.scope: Canonical CODE.1 and CODE.2 reconstructive C++ compiles and links as executable host code
gates.evidence: Recomp/README.md; Windows source-link runs including #34; original files stay intact
gates.limitation: Only source-backed call edges exercised, not a DOS game

gates.scope: Original CODE.1 and CODE.2 LE object, page and relocation images reconstructed and original-byte verified
gates.evidence: Recomp/ORIGINAL_LE_IMAGE_INTEGRATION_20261011.md; 12,430 authentic LE fixups, seven backward-page records
gates.limitation: Original images verified locally, CI has synthetic fixtures

gates.scope: Actual compiled original CODE.2 startup, all four initializers and original game-entry source are executed under bounded host fixtures
gates.limitation: No native DOS service completeness, and no real playable game

gates.scope: DOS/4GW memory, heap growth and DPMI selector lifecycle is implemented without test-only allocations
gates.limitation: Original CODE.1 natural CCDE -> CD97 mode2 -> FCE8 constructors (source 10E81/10438/FD6E with original DAC9/DAD9/104E0/10AA9/10DD7/10C46 allocation, not host retry) -> FC98 heap defaults, and all CODE.2 source DPMI, DOS48/49 fallback and 39E1C DS-break startup paths execute on host-managed source heaps. Windows canonical #148 source allocator 63/63; #153 original media SHA-256 identity and full existing suite 63/63. Shared checked DPMI 0006/0100/0101 selectors pass. R04 NOT accepted: no independently captured original DOS/4GW memory/selector receipts, limits, error and relocation lifetimes; source guest ABI/call-site boundary is still host bridged. CODE.1 character-creation 508C is an R06 boundary rather than a claim of R04 memory parity. See R04_CODE1_CD97_CONSTRUCTOR_HEAP_CHECKPOINT_20261012.md and R04_ORIGINAL_DOS_MEMORY_ORACLE_CAPTURE_PROTOCOL.md

gates.scope: Complete DOS filesystem and stream services execute original game resources on the canonical reconstructed code
gates.limitation: Bounded original SOUND.CFG read reaches mouse entry; full file service not implemented

gates.scope: Original CODE.1 character creation executes from original recompilation entry and hands over authentic CHARS state
gates.limitation: Separate native-engine character creation is not a qualifying recompilation

gates.scope: Game-visible DOS keyboard, mouse, timer, IRQ and interrupt behavior operates without synthetic branch outcomes
gates.limitation: Mouse branches and IVT are exercised only with explicit fixtures

gates.scope: Original CODE.2 VGA, palette, audio and resource renderer pipelines execute correctly as compiled reconstructed source
gates.limitation: Original source RES, VGA and native 1FC14 320x400 indexed/RGB6 frame paths pass the scoped Level23→26→23 saved-slot diagnostic (strict Windows #40321360454, 3 frame receipts). Whole-game renderer coverage, independently synchronized retail DOS pixels and genuine audible AIL parity remain unverified.

gates.scope: Actual compiled CODE.2 gameplay loop boots first real in-game level with interactive movement and input
gates.limitation: Original 1FC14 retains Level22 interactive native window and the saved Level23→26→23 private keyboard diagnostic returns to original 30B40 with 3 audited native frames. Physical portal entry through game-visible DOS keyboard/mouse/IRQ behavior and full player-input equivalence remain unverified.

gates.scope: All shipped levels, creatures, spells, scripted events and game completion paths operate in the recompilation
gates.limitation: Levels 22, 23 and 26 execute scoped original-source paths; not all 32 shipped levels, creatures, spells, scripts or game-completion behavior have run on the native recomp.

gates.scope: Authentic game saves, loads and CODE.1/CODE.2 transitions round-trip through full gameplay scenarios
gates.limitation: Authenticated original SAVE.DAT/LEV023.DAT restoration through compiled 07938 and genuine 23→26→23 original 171FC/181B4/2D3D8 private source-file roundtrip pass on one retained guest (strict Windows #40321360454). This is not full DOS save-menu/user-initiated save/load, CODE.1 character handoff or representative full-game save scenarios.

gates.scope: Independent original DOS versus recompilation behavioral regression corpus passes representative full-game scenarios
gates.limitation: No original-DOS full-game trace equivalence accepted
